description_zh:
欢迎游玩，非常简易！目前还没有完全做完，欢迎提建议！
WASD移动，鼠标调视角点击。底下物品栏切换物品，上方有提示下一步，也有箭头指示。B背包。可以存档！
主要玩法：种地、钓鱼、烹饪、养动物。
description_en:
Welcome to play! It is very simple for now and not fully finished yet. Suggestions are welcome!
Use WASD to move, move the mouse to adjust the view and click. Use the item bar at the bottom to switch items. Hints for the next step and arrow indicators are shown at the top. Press B for the backpack. Saving is supported!
Main gameplay: farming, fishing, cooking, and raising animals.
